questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order. **

As a result of greater competition

P: while others are contracting

Q: in the US computer industry

R: some computer companies are expanding
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'QRP'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• *Greater competition* must be explained as to competition regarding or in what? Q satisfies this criterion and therefore, Q is first. Rule out 1) and 3). Note how P and R state contrasting conditions (*expanding-contracting)*. Clearly, **others** will come after **some.** (e.g. A, B, and **others**).

***So the correct sentence is- ****As a result of greater competition in the US computer industry, some computer companies are expanding while others are contracting.*

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice. **

The teacher told him to collect assignments.

options.text: He was told to collect assignments by the teacher.
He is told by the teacher to collect assignments.
The teacher asked him to collect assignments.
He was asked to collect assignments.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'He was told to collect assignments by the teacher.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• **In the given sentence, **the subject is 'the teacher' and the verb is 'told' i.e. in the past tense and the object is 'him' this object is an indirect object. 'to collect assignments' is an infinitive phrase and the subject for this phrase is 'him'
 
• As the structure for the passive sentence is- 'Be + V3'

**So the correct passive is- He was told to collect assignments by the teacher.**

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect Speech. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct Speech. **

“I have not seen him for years,” said his mother.

options.text: She has not seen him for years said his mother.
His mother had not seen him for years.
His mother told him she had not saw him for years.
His mother said that she had not seen him for years.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'His mother said that she had not seen him for years. '**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

The given sentence is in 'Direct speech' we need to follow the following steps while changing Direct speech.

__
 
• #The first person of reported speech is changed according to the pronoun of the reporting verb.
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• She said, "I will go to London." (Direct speech)
 
• She said that she would go to London. (Indirect speech)
 
 
 
• #The first-person pronoun of reported speech is not changed if the pronoun of the reporting verb is also the first person.
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• I said, "I had applied for a job." (Direct speech.)
 
• I said I had applied for a job. (Indirect speech.)
 
 
 
• #The second person pronoun of the reported speech is changed according to the 'object' of the reporting verb.
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• She said to me, "You are a brilliant student." (Direct Speech)
 
• She told me that I was a brilliant student. (Indirect Speech)
 
• She said to them, "You are brilliant students" (Direct speech)
 
• She told them that they are brilliant students. (Indirect speech)
 
 
 
• #The third person pronoun of the reported speech will not be changed in indirect speech.
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• He said, "She will buy a pen." (Direct speech.)
 
• He said that she would buy a pen. (Indirect speech.)
 
 
 
• If the reporting verb is in the past tense and the reported speech is not an idiom/phrase/universal truth/routine/historical fact etc., the following changes will take place in the tense, time, and place of the reported speech. 
 
• **So the correct Indirect speech is- His mother said that she had not seen him for years. **

Weight of Roma is twice of the weight of Tipu: 4x,

So, value of p and q = 2,

M can complete 3/4 part of a work in 12 days and N can complete 2/7 part of the same work in 8 days. In how many days will both complete 11/14 part of the total work?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Time taken by M to complete 3/4 part of a work = 12 days

Time taken by M to complete whole work = 12 × 4/3 = 16 days

Time taken by N to complete 2/7 part of a work = 8 days

Time taken by N to complete whole work = 8 × 7/2 = 28 days

Total work = LCM of 16, 28 = 112 units

Efficiency of M = 112/16 = 7 units/day

Efficiency of N = 112/28 = 4 units/day

Efficiency of M and N together = 7 + 4 = 11 units/day

**∴ Time taken by M and N together to complete 11/14 part of work = 11/14 × 112 × 1/11 = 8 days**

questions.question:
Valency of an element depends on which of the following?

I. Number of losing electron

II. Number of gaining electron

III. Number of sharing electron
questions.solution:
__Explanation:__

__
 
• Valance Electrons: A valence electron is simply the total number of electrons present in the outermost shell of an atom.
 
• Valency: Valency is the number of** electrons an atom loses, gains or shares**__ with other atoms in order to get a stable configuration.

For example-

Atomic Configuration of Carbon (C ) is ( 6 ) = 2,4

__
 
• The valency of Carbon will be 4 as it needs 4 more electrons to get a stable configuration.
 
• The number of valence electrons in carbon is also four as its outermost shell contains 4 electrons.

Atomic Configuration of Nitrogen N ( 7 ) = 2,5

The valency of nitrogen is 3 as it needs 3 more electrons to complete its octet but the number of valence electrons in nitrogen is 5.

So, 

**It can be losing, gaining or sharing of electrons.**__

questions.question: In Microsoft Word, _______ contains tools for standard tasks like saving, printing, cutting, copying, pasting etc.
questions.solution: The standard toolbar provides a quick shortcut to many frequently used functions. You can customize the buttons that appear on the standard toolbar using the customize toolbar menu item. Standard toolbar functions are file commands, window commands etc.
